# Monitor pricing UI screenshots

These screenshots render the actual `MonitorPayAsYouGoCard` component with the repository's Tailwind styles in a local component preview. The fixture supplies a Free plan project with billing enabled. No component markup is recreated.

- `desktop.png`: 1440 × 448 viewport.
- `mobile.png`: 375 × 800 viewport.

The preview was also checked at 320px and 768px for clipping and horizontal overflow. The pricing link was activated with the keyboard and opened the expected destination in a separate tab.

The preview is isolated from the app server; these images do not represent a completed end-to-end monitor creation flow.
